entities.title: Command-line helpers
entities.summary: The logic behind the init, hook and report commands: wiring zazzle and zazzle-csharp-indexer into a project's Claude Code settings, deciding which raw reads and searches to redirect to zazzle, and summarising the usage log.
entities.purpose: Holds three static classes, one per command, that src/Program.cs calls: Init merges the indexer's server, zazzle's server when zazzled is installed, the hook and their permissions into .mcp.json and .claude/settings.json; HookPolicy classifies a Claude Code tool call; Report aggregates usage.jsonl into what to improve next.
boundaries: Reading standard input, writing the usage-log record for the hook and choosing the exit code are in src/Program.cs.
The usage log's format belongs to src/UsageLog.cs (src/.dev/observability.json); Report only reads it.
